name: Radial Pursuit
summary: Looking at a cluttered area makes the objects there spread out in a circle, and the object whose movement the eyes follow is selected.
howItWorks: When the gaze lands on a region, a bounding sphere of fixed radius gathers the objects inside it. These objects then move outward to evenly spaced positions on a circle. During the expansion the system accumulates the distance between the gaze point and each moving object; the object with the smallest total is selected if it is below a confidence threshold (smooth-pursuit matching). In a small study (N=8) on a cluttered scene it performed like gaze dwell on the same expanded layout, with higher satisfaction and lower fatigue.

relationships.note: Both select by matching smooth-pursuit eye movement to object motion.
